description: This file defines a SwiftUI view component `TailscaleIntegrationSection` for integrating Tailscale configuration into an app. It manages Tailscale modes, status, and authentication settings, including loading/saving configuration and interacting with a Tailscale service.

classes.name: GatewayTailscaleMode
classes.description: An enum representing different Tailscale modes: off, serve, and funnel.

classes.name: TailscaleIntegrationSection
classes.description: A SwiftUI view managing Tailscale configuration UI, status, and interactions.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Asynchronously loads Tailscale and gateway configuration from persistent store.

methods.name: applySettings
methods.description: Validates and applies Tailscale settings, updating the configuration accordingly.

methods.name: buildAndSaveTailscaleConfig
methods.description: Static async method to build and save the Tailscale-related configuration, returning success status and error message if any.

methods.name: restartGatewayIfNeeded
methods.description: Restarts the gateway service if in local connection mode and not paused.

methods.name: startStatusTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer to periodically check the Tailscale service status.
